name: echoloc_dataset (ZInD collection)
description: Zillow Indoor Dataset homes imported as an F3Loc-compatible floorplan localization collection, one scene per FLOOR: single-view (L = 0) 480x640 pinhole crops cut from each panorama at its own heading, wall-only maps from the annotated room layouts (doors between rooms opened, windows and exterior doors solid), SemRayLoc-style semantic maps (wall/window/door) from the same annotation, ray-cast depth GT, desdf, and floorplan_closed ring RIRs on the extruded map proxy. ZInD ships no mesh and no depth, so there is no raw_scan_open condition, no depth_radial_scan, and no rendering at new poses.

zind.motion: none: one crop per ZInD panorama position (is_inside panoramas only), heading = the panorama's own

excluded_scenes.note: floors without scale_meters_per_coordinate (284 of 2,737: no metric GT possible) and floors with no sealed floor plan or fewer than 2 usable panoramas (10) are absent; panoramas that are not is_inside, lie on a non-free map pixel, or sit < 5 cm from an obstacle are skipped (counted in scene_meta.json)

pose.format: poses.txt: one line per frame 'x y yaw', ascending in rgb filename order
pose.type: global SE(2) pose in the floorplan frame (not relative)
pose.rotation: yaw only (scalar, radians, [-pi, pi]), CCW from +x; roll = pitch = 0; no quaternion/matrix stored
pose.map_pixel: x_map = x/0.01 + W/2 (col), y_map = y/0.01 + H/2 (row); occ[row, col]; display with origin='lower'
pose.habitat_to_world: x = habitat_x - world_cx_habitat; y = -habitat_z - world_cy_habitat_neg_z; habitat theta (about +y, forward = -z) = yaw - pi/2   (per-scene offsets in maps/<scene>/scene_meta.json)
pose.height: per-frame camera height (chunks.json frames[].cam_z); the array/source sits at the same height

camera.source: 480x640 pinhole crop (cv2.remap, bilinear) of the 2048x1024 equirectangular panorama, look direction = the panorama's theta = 0 (room +y) mapped to the floor plan = poses.txt yaw; ~1:1 source pixels
camera.roll_pitch: 0 (ZInD panoramas are upright / gravity-aligned as shipped)
camera.height_above_floor_m: per frame (chunks.json frames[].cam_z = transformation scale x scale_meters_per_coordinate), median 1.44 m

map.source: zind_data.json layout_raw room polygons (floor_plan_transformation x scale_meters_per_coordinate) rasterised on a 0.05 m grid: free = union of the filled room polygons, obstacle = every cell bordering free space (the polygon outlines are NOT drawn as walls: per-panorama room estimates overlap), doors/openings reaching the floor opened unless they border the exterior, windows solid; upsampled x5 nearest

depth.angles: center_angs = flip(arctan2(u - u.mean(), ray_n * F_W)) + yaw
depth.value: camera-forward z-depth = ray range * cos(center_ang), metres
depth.ray_cast: echoloc_simulator/raycast.py (exact Amanatides-Woo DDA); NOT F3Loc utils.ray_cast, which skips wall-corner pixels on left/down steps and leaked 0.3-0.4% of rays

dirs.depth_radial_floorplan: floor-plan proxy rendered in habitat at the same pose (the only geometry available)

desdf.layout: {'l': int, 't': int, 'desdf': (H, W, 36)}; x_map = x_desdf*10 + l

pose_sampling.source: ZInD panorama positions as shipped (no sampling)

acoustics.binaural: NOT rendered for zind (ring only, as gibson); add later with LAYOUT=binaural ./run_all.sh rir
acoustics.pose_index: row of the collection's poses.txt (reference frames only, view 3)
acoustics.sample_rate_note: spec 8000; 48 kHz to match the earlier replica_0422/house_traj renders

headings.files: rel000 -> rir.npy (the mono ring has no directivity)

acoustics.source: co-located with the camera at the panorama's own height (per frame)
acoustics.diffraction_note: spec 4.3 lists diffraction=false; enabled deliberately because the dataset targets NLOS (cost-neutral in RLR)
acoustics.channel_render: RLR Mono x 6: receiver moved to each mic position, source fixed
acoustics.rir_shape: (6, n) float32 (n varies; RLR trims when energy is gone, ~0.4 s at ray depth 50)
acoustics.usable_window: rir[:, peak+guard : peak+guard+usable] (same 2 ms / 128 ms as the spec at 8 kHz)

replica_source.origin: Zillow Indoor Dataset (Bridge Data Output API, zind_download.py)

rir_version_history.settings: 8 kHz, 4096 rays, depth 6, diffraction OFF, ring 6ch only, 1 heading, (6, 2049)
rir_version_history.status: spec 4.3 verbatim; discarded and DELETED (NLOS needs diffraction)
aborted, deleted (sample rate/headings changed to match earlier renders)

rir_version_history.settings: 48 kHz, 20000 rays, depth 200, ring and binaural at 4 headings
rir_version_history.status: aborted, deleted (~36 h / ~300 GB for no information gain)

rir_version_history.settings: 48 kHz, 20000 rays, depth 50, diffraction on (order 10), ring 6ch rel 0 + binaural 2ch rel 0/90/180/270

deviations_from_spec: ray cast: exact DDA (echoloc_simulator/raycast.py) instead of F3Loc utils.ray_cast (corner-pixel leak)
RIR rendered for reference frames only (render_rir.py --all-views for every frame)
camera height 1.25 m chosen to co-locate with the acoustic source
RIR rendered WITH edge diffraction (spec acoustics block says false) — NLOS

RIR indirect rays 20000 and ray depth 50 instead of 4096 / 6: at 4096 rays identical re-renders correlate only ~0.74, and depth 6 drops all reflections beyond ~36 ms; depth 50 matches depth 200 (RLR default) in energy terms at 1/3 the cost
ZInD: single view per pose (no 4-view chunks); images are panorama crops, not renders
ZInD: only the floorplan_closed acoustic condition (no scan mesh exists); ring RIRs only, no binaural
ZInD: camera height per frame (the dataset's own), not 1.25 m

semantic_maps.source: zind_data.json layout_raw doors / windows (wall-opening segments), drawn on the obstacle shell; openings carry no label, opened doors are free pixels (their jambs are labelled)

split_source: ZInD's own home-level partition (floorplan_extraction/zind_partition.json), expanded to floors
